ABOUT US

Protecting New Jersey & Pennsylvania Since 1977

  • — NJ License: #P01629
  • — NJ Fire Safety Certification: #195457

Alert Sprinkler was established in 1977 and incorporated in 1978. For over 45 years we have been the trusted name in fire sprinkler protection across New Jersey and southeastern Pennsylvania — covering the full lifecycle from engineering and design through installation, inspection, repair, and maintenance.

We are a union company. Every one of our fitters has completed a rigorous 5-year apprenticeship program, and we've been fortunate to retain the same core crew for over 25 years. We place a high value on employee loyalty — because we believe it's what allows us to deliver the best possible service to our customers.

GOT QUESTIONS

Frequently Asked Questions

What areas do you service? +

We are licensed to operate throughout New Jersey and southeastern Pennsylvania. We've been serving both states since 1977.

How often does my fire sprinkler system need to be inspected? +

NFPA 25 requires inspections on a quarterly, semi-annual, and annual basis depending on the system components. We'll put together a compliant schedule specific to your facility.

Are you licensed and insured? +

Yes. We hold NJ License #P01629 and NJ Fire Safety Certification #195457. We carry full general liability and workers' compensation coverage.

Do you handle emergency repairs? +

Yes — our rapid-response teams are available 24 hours a day, 365 days a year. Call us at 732-521-1666 any time.

What types of buildings do you work on? +

We serve commercial, industrial, institutional, and residential facilities — from high-rises and warehouses to hospitals, schools, and multi-family housing.

Can you retrofit an existing building with a sprinkler system? +

Absolutely. Retrofitting existing structures is one of our core specialties. Our engineers will assess your building and design a system that meets current code requirements.

Ready to Secure Your Facility?

Our technical specialists are available to review your blueprints or perform a site inspection today.
